grandparents_cupboard.reason: Potatoes, tinned beans and tomatoes, spring onions, garlic, spinach, oil and smoked paprika are all plain home-kitchen foods.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at an ordinary price.

basic_kitchen.reason: A large frying pan with a lid and basic frying and simmering are all it needs.

works.reason: The potatoes are fried until golden, then simmered for 5 minutes in the tinned tomatoes and beans, so they turn soft and the 'crispy potatoes' in the title won't survive; serving the beans over the potatoes instead would fix it.

honest_times.reason: The steps add up to about 25 to 27 minutes of cooking (10 + 8–10 + 1 + 5 + wilting), not the 22 printed, making it roughly 37 minutes in all for a breakfast asked to be quick.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the chives, is used, and the steps add nothing unlisted.

seasonal_feel.reason: Potatoes are the bulk of the dish and suit a cool mid-April morning, with spring onions and spinach in season.

plain_voice.reason: Short, clear British instructions a beginner can follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Potatoes, two tins of beans, tomatoes and spinach make a filling, wholesome breakfast with protein and vegetables.
